versions.changelog:
time-cycles v0.1.0

- Initial release based on John Murphy’s《期货市场技术分析》第十四章.
- Activated when user asks about time cycles, seasonality, or uses peak left/right shift for turning points.
- Distinguishes time cycle analysis from Elliott wave counting and moving average signals.
- Outlines methodology: measure cycles trough-to-trough, determine hierarchical direction, use peak shifts to judge trend, require confirmation by traditional signals, avoid bottom-fishing cycles in bear markets.
- Provides practical examples (CRB 10.5-month, 28-day, soybean seasonality) and clear usage boundaries.
